$description: Dark mode color overrides for johnthedesigner.com. Applied via @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark). Tonal shift model — not inversion. Only tokens that change between light and dark are defined here.

surface.$description: Dark mode page surface — slate-900. Deep neutral, cool-tinted. Not true black.

surface-raised.$description: Dark mode raised surface — slate-800. Cards, sheets sit one step lighter than base.

surface-overlay.$description: Dark mode overlay surface — slate-700. Modals and dialogs one step above raised.

surface-subtle.$description: Dark mode subtle surface — same as raised. Slate-50 in light mode becomes slate-800 in dark.

on-surface.$description: Dark mode heading/display text — pure white. 18.07:1 on slate-900 — AA ✓

on-surface-body.$description: Dark mode body text — slate-100. Lighter than slate-200 used previously; 13.18:1 on slate-900 — AA ✓. Not pure white — preserves readability and avoids harsh contrast.

on-surface-muted.$description: Dark mode muted text — slate-300. 4.88:1 on slate-900 — AA ✓

on-surface-placeholder.$description: Dark mode placeholder — slate-400. 3.02:1 on slate-900 — passes non-text 3:1 ✓ for placeholder context.

primary.$description: Primary fill color unchanged in dark mode — blue-450 holds its vibrancy against the dark surface.

primary-text.$description: Dark mode interactive text — blue-300. Tonal shift from blue-550 light. 9.2:1 on slate-900 — AAA ✓

primary-hover.$description: Dark mode hover for primary fills — blue-400, one step lighter than blue-450.

primary-subtle.$description: Dark mode subtle blue tint — blue-900. Used for ghost button hover backgrounds.

border-focus.$description: Dark mode focus ring — blue-400. More visible against dark surfaces than blue-450.

error.$description: Error fill unchanged — pastel red remains readable in dark mode context. Slate-900 text: 9.19:1 — AA ✓

success.$description: Success fill unchanged. Slate-900 text: 11.84:1 — AA ✓

warning.$description: Warning fill unchanged. Slate-900 text: 14.25:1 — AA ✓

error-surface.$description: Dark mode error surface tint — deep red-tinted dark. Decorative only.

success-surface.$description: Dark mode success surface tint — deep green-tinted dark. Decorative only.

warning-surface.$description: Dark mode warning surface tint — deep amber-tinted dark. Decorative only.
